notes: The complementizer that placed on the infinitive προσμένειν rather than on παρεκάλει (rule 85), giving a discontinuous unit under rule 15.
The dative of the compound προσμένω takes unto the on the article under rule 21, an English verb word cleave being written for the verb (rule 106).
τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ: the second attributive article stands before a verbless genitive modifier for which the ASV supplies no relative clause, so rule 31's closing clause leaves it unrepresented.
